opening.argument: The video promises more than 100 AVAX easily through a contract-based process: viewers are told to send AVAX to the contract, deploy the setup, and call its flashloan function. The proposed profit mechanism is rapid trading combined with an inflated token value, while the speaker reports, “We went $200 to $1,775.00.” The description further suggests that increasing the gas fee can produce more than the amount shown and urges viewers to spread the method. Although AVAX appears in a wallet and a conversion page supplies market context, those records do not independently verify the contract, recipient control, profitability, or any viewer outcome. The staking-gift banner is separate advertising, and the available frame does not establish a completed deployment or transaction.
